products.title: Hiboy S2 Lite Electric Scooter for Teens

description.html: When seeking a safe and comfortable electric scooter for your teen's first riding experience, the Hiboy S2 Lite stands out with its exceptional performance. Its vibrant design and sleek style make commuting enjoyable and help your kids stand out in crowds. Available in pink and black, the Hiboy S2 Lite caters to different preferences. Equipped with a 36V 5Ah battery, it offers a maximum range of 10.6 miles and a top speed of 13 mph. The scooter fully charges in just 3.5 to 4.5 hours, ensuring quick preparation for the next ride. Its 6.5-inch solid tires provide a smooth journey. The Hiboy S2 Lite features dual brakes, including an ABS E-brake and a rear pedal brake, for enhanced control and stopping power. This lightweight scooter combines geometric design frames, components, and accessories in a simple yet elegant package. With its colorful blend and suitable size, the Hiboy S2 Lite delivers style, safety, and an exciting riding experience for your kids. Additionally, the Hiboy S2 Lite is equipped with a headlight on the stem, providing excellent illumination for safer night riding. This electric scooter excels in performance while reflecting thoughtful consideration for safety and convenience in its details. Choose the Hiboy S2 Lite for a safe and stylish riding experience for your teens/ kids.

description.html: An electric scooter is faster and more efficient than a motor or kick scooter. The Hiboy KS4 Pro Premium electric scooter is the best fit for riders looking for a powerful yet lightweight electric scooter. With a high speed of 19 mph, it smoothly achieves 25 miles of travel range per charge under specific conditions. It suits city commuting and traveling, helping you conquer up to a 15% grade slope. The powerful 500 W motor makes it ideal for city commuting and extended travel. It has 10-inch honeycomb tires for a stable ride and three brilliant light systems: headlight, taillight, and sidelight, for riding safely at night. The Hiboy KS4 Pro Premium electric scooter also has a 36 V 11.6 Ah battery, dual rear suspensions, customized cruise and speed control, and dual braking.
